answer: Anonymous personhood credentials. For horizon images of an onyx quarry or summit, require a proof of one enrolled human and an epoch-specific nullifier; reject any reused nullifier before rewarding a submission. Splitting one credential among N accounts leaves only one payable claim. N rewarded identities require N distinct people, so an attacker must recruit them and bear their participation costs. This assumes reliable enrollment deduplication; credential rental still permits attacks at a per-person cost.
